Techniques (not code verbatim, and no map data) adapted from https://github.com/mrdoob/slop-newyork,
MIT licensed (LICENSE here). Each adapted file names it in its header: js/render/post.js (grade,
MSAA), daylight.js (white balance looks), roadSurface.js (damp masks), canyon.js (canyon sky AO).
No NYC/OSM data is used.
